mapper.select: SELECT ss.asof_date AS report_date, sd.name AS strategy_name, ss.score, ss.recommendation, ss.features_json, ss.data_quality FROM signal_snapshot ss JOIN strategy_definition sd ON ss.strategy_id = sd.id ORDER BY ss.asof_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signal_snapshot (asof_date, strategy_id, score, recommendation, features_json, data_quality) VALUES (#{asof_date}, #{strategy_id}, #{score}, #{recommendation}, #{features_json}, #{data_quality})
mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.name, ar.condition_json, ar.channel, ar.enabled, ar.created_at, ae.triggered_at AS last_triggered, ae.message AS last_message, ae.status AS last_status FROM alert_rule ar LEFT JOIN alert_event ae ON ar.id = ae.rule_id AND ae.triggered_at = ( SELECT MAX(ae2.triggered_at) FROM alert_event ae2 WHERE ae2.rule_id = ar.id ) ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_rule (name, condition_json, channel, enabled, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{condition_json}, #{channel}, #{enabled}, datetime('now'))
